description: EU Reference Scenario 2020 (DG ENER/CLIMA/MOVE, July 2021), PRIMES-GAINS-GLOBIOM, EU27, 2005-2050. Reference projection of adopted policies (no post-2030 target); not intended to reach the targets. Note: the 2021 Fit-for-55 policy scenarios (REG, MIX, MIX-CP) were published only to 2030 and are not screenable.
